description: This file defines a Flutter widget, BookCard, which displays information about a book, including the cover, title, author, and an optional trailing widget. It manages user interaction such as tapping to navigate to a reader view.

classes.name: BookCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a book's cover image, title, author, and optionally additional trailing widget; handles tap to navigate to a reader view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the BookCard, including the card layout and navigation upon tap.

methods.name: _cover
methods.description: Returns a widget displaying the book's cover image or a placeholder icon if the cover URL is missing.
